preservedReceiving.semantics: RemoveLocation required all tags absent, matching older crop-only implementation that treated RemoveLocation as RemoveAll.

actualCanonicalEEC.semantics: RemoveLocation preserves title/comment and removes latitude/longitude/altitude, distinct from RemoveAll.

shortRequiredExcerpt: Picture's Info/Metadata view exposes available dimensions, format, file size, colour profile, capture date, camera/lens/exposure details, orientation, location and other supported EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata. Unknown metadata should be preserved through non-destructive round trips where possible.
Export/privacy controls MUST support preserving metadata, removing location metadata and removing all removable metadata where the target format supports it.
liveSpecification.interpretation: Preserve, remove-location, and remove-all are separate controls. Treating remove-location as remove-all erases non-location metadata and is not canonical semantic parity.

existingFailurePreserved: Original native Picture GPS Preserve failure remains open; the RemoveLocation semantic mismatch does not waive or explain away that original failed preserve control.
ownerActionRequested: Native Picture owner must supply/acknowledge the coherent native project/source/test revision and actual metadata export acceptance for Preserve/RemoveLocation/RemoveAll, including GPS/EXIF/XMP removal and preserved non-location metadata. Team C retains prior native test bytes and requests owner delivery, without editing active native ownership or relabeling browser carrier tests as full native adoption.
runtimeQualification: C5 separate Picture15 carrier uses exact3-source BrowserEngine; any actual failure must retain its precise mechanism. Full native Picture project is not composed by the two-body dependency proposal.
